exerciseInstructions: 1Hold the TRX straps with an underhand grip and lean back and away from the anchor point.
2Keep your elbows high as you flex your elbows. Pull your fists toward your forehead.
1Stand facing the TRX straps and grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing away from your body.
2Walk back until the straps are taut, keeping your arms straight.
3Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
1Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
2Maintain a neutral grip. Flex your elbows and pull your fists to either sides of your temples.
1Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the strap is taut.
2Start with an overhand grip. Pull your elbows back and rotate your grip.
3By the time your elbows reach your side, your palms should be facing upwards.
1Hold the TRX strap with one hand.
2Lean back until the strap is taut. Fully extend your elbow.
3Pull your elbow behind the body. Make sure to avoid twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.
1Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
2Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
3Keeping your arms straight, slowly lift your arms out to the side, keeping them at the same height as your shoulders. Your body should form a "T" shape.
1Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
2Pull your elbows back while externally rotating your shoulder joint. Your arms should make a W shape at the back portion of the exercise.
1Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
2Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
3Slowly lower your body down to the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
4When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.
1Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
2Step away so your body is leaning away from the anchor point.
3Flex your elbows and pull your elbows straight back behind your body.
4Make sure to keep your elbows flared outward.
1Lie face down on the ground and place your forearms on the ground directly under your shoulders.
2With your feet in the stirrups, kick both feet into the TRX straps and hold the handles above your head.
3Tighten your abs, glutes, and legs to form a straight line from your head to your feet.
1Start by facing away from the TRX straps and placing your feet in the TRX handles with your palms on the ground.
2Lift your knees off the ground to begin the set.
3Engage your core and maintain this position for the desired amount of time, holding a steady plank.
1Begin in a kneeling position with the TRX straps adjusted to mid-calf length.
2Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
3Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
4Slowly lower your body down to the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
1Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
2Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.
1Stand facing away from the anchor point, holding onto the TRX handles with both hands.
2Step your left foot behind your right, crossing it behind your right leg, and lower yourself into a curtsy lunge.
3Push through your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat the movement with the other leg.
1Lie on your back with your feet in the foot cradles of the TRX straps, with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
2Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
3Drive your hips up towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes and hamstrings at the top of the movement.
1Start in a plank position with the TRX straps adjusted to mid-calf length. Place your feet in the TRX stirrups.
2Keep your abs engaged, and bring one knee towards your chest while keeping the other leg extended behind you.
3Switch legs, bringing the opposite knee towards your chest while keeping your abs engaged and your back straight.
1Hold the TRX straps under your arms and the handles in your armpits.
2Lean forward against the straps.
3Keep your body straight and initiate the calf raise by raising your heels off the ground.
1Place your feet in the stirrups and get in to a plank position.
2Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
3Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.
1Grasp the TRX handles with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
2Step laterally to one side, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.
3Lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your front knee bent at a 90-degree angle and your back leg straight.
4Push off your front foot to return to the starting position, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.
1Hold on to the TRX straps and step away until the strap is taut.
2Step backwards with one leg in to a lunge position and gently tap your knee to the floor.
3Lunge back to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.
1Stand facing the TRX straps and place your feet shoulder-width apart.
2Begin by lowering into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
3Explosively jump up off the ground, using your arms for momentum if desired.
4Land softly back in the squat position, making sure to absorb the impact with your legs.
1Hold the two TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
2Flex at the hips and knees in to a squat position.
3You can use your arms and the straps to assist you back into the starting position.
1Hold the two TRX straps and step away until the straps are taut. Take a split stance.
2Bring your back knee to the floor and gently tap the floor.
3Use your arms and the TRX to help assist you getting back into the starting position.
1Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the straps are taut.
2Keep both elbows mostly extended and raise both arms out and upwards.
3You should make a Y shape with your arms during the back portion of the exercise.
1Start by setting up the TRX straps to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
2Stand facing the TRX straps, grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
3Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
4Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.
1Stand facing the TRX straps and hold onto the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
2Keeping your core engaged, slowly raise your arms forward until they are overhead.
3Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
1Start by facing the TRX straps and positioning yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ground and your feet in the TRX foot cradles.
2Keeping your core engaged and body in a straight line, bend your knees and bring your heels towards your glutes.
3Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
1Lie on your side with your legs straight and your feet resting in the TRX foot cradles.
2Prop yourself up on your forearm and engage your core to maintain a straight line from your head to your feet.
1Hold the two TRX straps and lean forward. The straps should be over each shoulder.
2Keep your elbows tucked in and then flex and extend at the elbows.
1Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
2Pull both knees to your right elbow.
3Extend your legs back to the starting position, then pull both knees to the left elbow.
1Start by adjusting the TRX straps to chest height. Stand facing the TRX with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
3Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
4Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.
